_help: Edit this file while the server is stopped, or run /sintel config reload after editing it. This config is intentionally global permissions/control only. Smoke emitters are stored in each world save so they do not leak between maps.

serverControl._help: Server-authoritative mode is always enabled. The client renders smoke, but the server owns placement, permissions, and world-specific emitter storage.

permissions._help: Global access can come from Fabric Permissions API nodes (sintel.builder / sintel.admin) and/or Sintel's internal builder list. Set enableInternalBuilderList=false for servers that want LuckPerms/Fabric permissions to be the only global access source. opFallbackForAdmin lets vanilla ops count as Sintel admins when no/insufficient permission node is configured.
